exactness.conditional_actions: All 51 actor/action conditional rewards computed without division by action probabilities.
exactness.reciprocal: 24 disjoint pair-execution events; multiply only two participant probabilities, marginalizing all 17 third-person proposals.
exactness.stable_log: No epsilon, floor, clipping, reward rescaling, or action support reduction.
exactness.strict: All old objective arrays, nine network gradients, and existing training row values exactly equal old utility(alpha=.5).

interfaces.objective_terms: (logits, rewards, rule) -> old utility fields plus rule, execution_probability, action_conditioned_expected_reward
interfaces.training_gradients: (networks, observations, rewards, live, uniforms, update, rule) -> gradients, row

numerical_sender_scope: Finite differences hold sampled discrete messages and paired trajectory advantages fixed; they test the stopped LOO surrogate, not a pathwise derivative through categorical tokens.
physical_reference: Independent test settlement enumerates all17^3 joint proposals for three stated need/layout worlds, for both rules.
